hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Abdullah ibn Mas'ud that he used to say: 'You must adhere to truthfulness, for indeed truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise. And beware of lying, for indeed lying leads to wickedness, and wickedness leads to the Fire. Do you not see that it is said: he spoke the truth and was righteous, and he lied and was wicked.' And it reached Malik that it was said to Luqman: 'What has brought you to what we see?' - meaning virtue. So Luqman said: 'Truthfulness in speech, fulfilling the trust, and leaving what does not concern me.'

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِك أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ ، كَانَ يَقُولُ : " عَلَيْكُمْ بِالصِّدْقِ فَإِنَّ الصِّدْقَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْبِرِّ ، وَالْبِرَّ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ ، وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَالْكَذِبَ فَإِنَّ الْكَذِبَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْفُجُورِ ، وَالْفُجُورَ يَهْدِي إِلَى النَّارِ ، أَلَا تَرَى أَنَّهُ يُقَالُ : صَدَقَ وَبَرَّ ، وَكَذَبَ وَفَجَرَ " . وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِك أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ ، أَنَّهُ قِيلَ لِلُقْمَانَ : مَا بَلَغَ بِكَ مَا نَرَى يُرِيدُونَ الْفَضْلَ ، فَقَالَ لُقْمَانُ : صِدْقُ الْحَدِيثِ ، وَأَدَاءُ الْأَمَانَةِ ، وَتَرْكُ مَا لَا يَعْنِينِي

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated from Safwan ibn Sulaym that he said: It was said to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: 'Can a believer be cowardly?' He said: 'Yes.' Then it was said to him: 'Can a believer be miserly?' He said: 'Yes.' Then it was said to him: 'Can a believer be a liar?' He said: 'No.'

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : قِيلَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : " أَيَكُونُ الْمُؤْمِنُ جَبَانًا ؟ فَقَالَ : نَعَمْ " ، فَقِيلَ لَهُ : " أَيَكُونُ الْمُؤْمِنُ بَخِيلًا ؟ فَقَالَ : نَعَمْ " ، فَقِيلَ لَهُ : " أَيَكُونُ الْمُؤْمِنُ كَذَّابًا ؟ فَقَالَ : لَا "

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Abu Hurayrah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Indeed, Allah is pleased with three things for you and displeased with three things for you. He is pleased for you that you worship Him and not associate anything with Him, and that you hold fast to the rope of Allah all together, and that you give sincere advice to the one whom Allah has put in charge of your affairs. And He is displeased for you with idle talk, wasting wealth, and excessive questioning.'

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Abu Hurayrah that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Among the worst of people is the two-faced one, who comes to these people with one face and to those people with another face.'
